text.text: Plan the week on the calendar, link each lesson to standards and resources, and write one line of reflection straight after teaching.
Which standards have been taught, and which are still waiting.
Standards with zero lessons are gaps in the year's plan. Link a standard to a lesson plan and its Times taught count goes up.
A standard with zero times taught after the midpoint of the term needs a lesson on the calendar.
Times taught of 0: plan a lesson for this standard.
Times taught of 1: consider one more practice lesson.
Times taught of 3 or more: check that other standards are not being squeezed.
Mark lessons Taught and add a rating
Note changes for lessons that went badly
